say:0:1520429001:1.text: The pot still holds remnants of the previous spoiled soup, reeking of rot. How hungry must someone be to force this down?
say:0:1520429001:1.source_cn: 锅里依然残留着不少之前留剩的变质肉汤，散发着一股腐败腥...

say:1:1520429002:1.text: You pinch your nose and peer inside. The meat at the bottom is half-dried, half-rotten sludge.
say:1:1520429002:1.source_cn: 你捂着鼻子，又向锅内瞟了一眼。沉在锅底的腐肉一半干枯，...
say:1:1520429002:1.male: You pinch your nose and peer inside. The meat at the bottom is half-dried, half-rotten sludge.
say:1:1520429002:1.female: You pinch your nose and peer inside. The meat at the bottom is half-dried, half-rotten sludge.

say:2:1520429003:1.text: If you hadn't known it was meat soup, you'd think it was swamp bark covered in pale moss.
say:2:1520429003:1.source_cn: 如果不是提前知道锅里的是肉汤，你甚至觉得它们应该是沼泽...
say:2:1520429003:1.male: If you hadn't known it was meat soup, you'd think it was swamp bark covered in pale moss.
say:2:1520429003:1.female: If you hadn't known it was meat soup, you'd think it was swamp bark covered in pale moss.

say:3:1520429004:1.text: Whatever it was, it no longer resembled normal meat.
say:3:1520429004:1.source_cn: 无论如何，这都不像是一个正常动物的肉。

say:4:1520429005:1.text: The famine had claimed not only the people of Halia, but also the pitiful beasts of this land...
say:4:1520429005:1.source_cn: 看来饥荒影响的不仅是呼临人，还有这片土地上的可怜动物……
